exposure: consumption of egg and/or flesh food
cohort: The study included a maternal-child birth cohort (DHANI) of 902 live births in Belagavi, Karnataka, India, with 878 mother-child pairs completing 12-month follow up.
finding: The study found varying IYCF practices, with 77.9% early initiation of breastfeeding, 52.4% exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months, 90% breastfed at 12 months, and 85.8% consuming ultra-processed foods.
